<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 262.09938. This mass matches the exact monoisotopic mass of the neutral formula C₁₈H₁₄O₂ (216 + 14.10955 + 31.9898 = 262.09935 Da). The isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1) is consistent with ~18 carbons, supporting this formula. Therefore the molecular formula of the molecule in the sample is C18H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H14O2</final_answer>
